title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, three tool-calling quickstarts (HTTP lookup, database query, and calendar assistant), and supporting docs site updates. Motivation: provide reproducible, production-oriented examples for customers evaluating agents and tool calling with Redwood, reduce onboarding time for common integrations, and standardize templates for internal training and benchmarks. This PR includes markdown guides, ready-to-run example configs, TypeScript and Python example clients, updated sidebar entries on the docs site, and small changes to the examples CI so quickstarts run in the docs smoke tests. Checklist: - Add RAG agent template docs and example YAML/JSON templates - Add three quickstarts with runnable examples and Dockerfiles - Update docs site navigation and landing page snippets - Add smoke test to examples CI and greenkeeper entries - Add migration notes for existing examples Testing: smoke tests for examples run in CI, manual end-to-end verification against a local vector store (we used a mini Pinecone-compatible test harness), unit tests for example utilities, and linting/docs build locally. Backwards compatibility: examples are additive only and do not change public SDK APIs. See release_notes field for user-facing notes.
